production_contract: Actual Rust Engine, access-only device Session, managed Review transport, state/support decoder and exact source replay; authenticated same-origin Cloud capability and expected-model pin.
calibration_role: Diagnostic only. Calibrate every state and support context on the calibration split; runtime uses explicit support/state choices without a fitted threshold.
identity_evidence: provider_reported_version; exact returned dated model, actual provider, requested upstream and official endpoint are pinned. No independently verified remote artifact or serving revision is claimed.

acceptance.hosted_warm_complete_job_p95: within the frozen configured whole-job deadline, never over 90 seconds

items: Independently authored SOURCE0 state and kind-support judgments. Complete-item metrics include original four state components only, exact literal quotes and every frozen central/adjacent source anchor. Unsupported owner/due/prior extraction remains null. Easy support rows cannot inflate item F1.
calibration: Only calibration distributions fit artifacts. Actual authored physical template, slot, batch size, question, label order, provider/model and grouping bind each context. Require actual export coverage across every intended split before inference; commit fitted lock before heldout.
resource_scope: Five fresh isolated Python coordinators and thirty retained-coordinator complete jobs, each owning a fresh real Rust Engine CLI for the complete original job. All physical batches share that Engine and one 90-second deadline. RSS is maximum individual-process lifetime high-water mark over the isolated coordinator and waited Rust child; remote server/GUI/aggregate process-tree RSS unmeasured.
adoption: Emit a candidate only after unchanged exact-source, original-job, state/item/precision/resource gates and separate raw/calibrated support quality gates pass. Never write the registry or reuse failed A/B quality credit.
support_abstention: Unclear or model-abstained support is a null prediction counted as a missed class/coverage loss, not a third event class. Retain its raw distribution for calibration. State unknown remains a real state.
transport: pennel-review-v3 / supported_passages_v3; client UUID and expected_model pin; canonical upstream Perplexity alias and fixed no-fallback/ZDR policy. Captures parsed service JSON before decision decoding, not raw HTTP bytes or observed upstream wire.
authentication: Short-lived device access token only via anonymous inherited pipe. No refresh token, OS credential lookup, account/device creation or refresh traffic. Stop on 401 or expiry; freeze each phase inside its usable TTL.
